CustomField.description: This is for visibility of System Admin, Utkarsh Admin, and Same dept CRM Head, HOD, Owner
CustomField.formula: OR( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator", $Profile.Name = "Utkarsh Admin", OwnerId = $User.Id, AND( OR( Department__c = $User.Department, CONTAINS(Department__c, $User.Department) ), OR( OwnerId = $User.Id, $Profile.Name = "Utkarsh HOD", $Profile.Name = "CRM Head" ) ) )
CustomField.label: Departments Match
